resources.string: Say for example: “climate on”, “warmer”, “navigate home”, “next song”, “range”.
Horn, indicators, lights and alarm are never possible by voice.
Route home is shown. Tap Start on the map to begin guidance.
No home saved yet. Save “Home” in the navigation first.
Say “yes” or “no”, or tap. No answer means no.
Voice commands are off. Switch them on under Settings → System.
The climate is already at its limit.
The current climate level cannot be read. Nothing was changed.
The range is not known right now.
The place is not known offline right now.
Panoptes is recording sound right now. The microphone stays closed.
The wake word is off. Switch it on under Settings → System.
Panoptes cannot recognise voice commands in this language yet (German and English only).

Without microphone permission there are no voice commands.
